To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the semantic-enrichment process is a promising technique for automatically conceptualizing and annotating tables, and that the process is effective for discovering semantic concepts, semantic relationships, and semantic constraints from human-readable tables.

(1) the semantic-enrichment approach can successfully be applied to the automatic conceptualization of web tables; (2) the semantic-en richment approach performs well, with F-measures of around 90%, in the automatic annotation of web tables; and (3) our approach is general enough to apply to a broad range of web tables.
(1) the automatic conceptualization of tables is possible, and (2) the semantic-enrichment technique is a promising approach to achieve this.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the automatic conceptualization of a table and the automatic annotation of the table's data values with respect to the conceptualized table structure.
how to automatically conceptualize, populate, and annotate a human- readable table with semantically coherent ontologies.
